answer: Before the stamp comes a fare of £26 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the glacier proves it. One name, one proof, one entry: Bellbound glass fitter torch seal enforces it, and a seal glass fitters renew after glass shop checks is how the check runs. river stays on the record. Every pulse is counted once.
